comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector; record reorients and clamps an angle-grinder guard.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate probes beneath a small tab while controlling a wire; record stabilizes a power tool, opens a clamp lever, rotates a guard, and reclamps it without contacting the disc.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires intact selective terminal extraction; record requires the guard facing the operator, lever flat, grinder near its start pose, and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Rotational guard adjustment and clamp management are unrelated to depinning.
